vkCreateDevice pAllocator ignored (host call gets NULL): host-memory callbacks would have to be re-entered into the PE caller from driver threads that are not Wine threads (no PE context); Vulkan spec 'Memory Allocation' chapter makes them optional-to-observe (VK_SYSTEM_ALLOCATION_SCOPE_DEVICE); design decision, see ESCALATE.md 'winevulkan allocators'. CORE review

vkCreateInstance pAllocator ignored: as vkCreateDevice (scope INSTANCE); instance create/destroy run on the calling Wine thread so a limited implementation (callbacks only during Create/Destroy on the calling thread) is possible but needs the unix->PE callback path of 0 existing allocator users; design decision, ESCALATE.md. CORE review
vkDestroyDevice pAllocator ignored: pair of vkCreateDevice; must use the same allocator for the free callbacks, so cannot be done alone; ESCALATE.md. CORE review
